comments.author: Igor
comments.body:
The skils are cute, but not fantastic, and the quest is not extremely hard. So I would guess around 10m (for the one without theology ofc).

Now, I step back and wait for people to insult me because it's too much, or too few. If both happen, my estimate was about right.
